note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled 28 May 1914: contests in Ballymartrim, Brootally, Clady, Glenaul and Middletown. Labels are printed only in the results of the contests. Returned unopposed. Printed "Ahorey". James Creggan: no party label printed in 1914. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Aghory, 25 May 1905, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 2 June 1905, p. 5 (Armagh rural district council results, counted by Mr. Calvert); nominations from the Armagh Guardian, 28 April 1905, p. 5 ("Guardians' Nominations"; "All the candidates are Unionists save where marked N.") and Armagh Guardian, 5 May 1905, p. 4 ("Poor Law Guardians": contests and withdrawals); Aghory, 29 May 1924, printed 'U': Northern Whig, 1 May 1924, p. 10 ("Armagh Rural District"); Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1924, p. 2 ("Armagh Rural Council": nominations with party labels)).
